answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, since the cedar funding graph is rebuilt from the willow history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 258 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 258 bonds yet holds one position, and the nadir report publishes the merged exposure. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
